gen-gf-goldman-sora: Wide, loud and low-slung, Goldman stretches across the top while Sora follows underneath, a plain sans whose curves turn corners without any swelling. Make Sora a touch larger than feels natural.
gen-gf-goldman-space-grotesk: Commanding from the first glance, Goldman spreads its low, wide capitals like a banner. Space Grotesk sits beneath as a plain sans of thread-thin, constant lines, with a moderate lowercase that gives the heading plenty of room to dominate.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-amulya: Amulya reads as a contemporary sans-serif, its curves leaving generous gaps that keep every letter easy to tell apart. And Grandstander, with its tall x-height and uniform strokes, adds a bolder voice that makes a long run of text feel lively.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-chillax: Grandstander is tall in the lowercase and bold in attitude. Chillax follows as a relaxed sans with unfinished, pen-lifted loops, so a long stretch of text drifts along loosely, never stiff, with a moderate lowercase height that stays out of the heading's way.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-plein: Chunky, open and friendly, Grandstander draws tall lowercase letters with no contrast between its stems and joins, while Plein stays low and reliable as a plain sans. Long text feels tidy.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-roundo: Roundo reads as a tidy sans-serif, its n built with arch and stem matching. Grandstander shouts in tall, expressive display letters above it, and the lower, quieter body keeps that energy from spilling into the text.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-spline-sans: Short ascenders and a tall x-height give Grandstander a stout, bold look with every stroke held open. Spline Sans follows as an approachable sans-serif with wide gaps at the curves, so a long passage moves along without crowding.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-synonym: Grandstander's most distinctive trait is its plain, constant-width line, bold and expressive with letters held open rather than curled shut. Synonym answers in a dependable sans, a stripe of constant ink with generous openings, so extended reading stays clean and untiring.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-aclonica: Grandstander's line looks like spaghetti laid out in letters, bold and expressive with a tall x-height. And Aclonica brings a stretched, widely spaced sans with a barely felt thickness shift, so its quiet manner is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-alumni-sans: Grandstander is bold and round, with no pinching at the curves. Alumni Sans, a plain sans with low ascenders and a wide-open c, does the quieter work of staying tidy, its stems just slightly thicker than the connecting strokes.
